tool_signatures.name: boldem_create_campaign
tool_signatures.description:
Create a new mass email campaign. You need a template ID and at least one mailing list.
Use boldem_list_templates to find templates and boldem_list_mailing_lists for mailing lists.

The subject line lives on the template, not on the campaign — set it with
boldem_manage_template if you need to change it.

mailing_list_ids.description: Mailing list IDs to send the campaign to

from_address.description: Sender email address (From). Required for sending/testing the campaign.

dispatcher_id.description: Dispatcher (sender) ID. Use boldem_list_dispatchers to find available ones.

web_track_param.description: Web tracking parameter appended to links (e.g. UTM tagging)

parameters.description: Mailing list IDs to send the campaign to

parameters.description: Template ID to use for the campaign

parameters.description: Web tracking parameter appended to links (e.g. UTM tagging)

tool_signatures.description:
Create or update (upsert) a contact in Boldem. If a contact with the given email
already exists, it will be updated according to overwrite_mode. You can assign the contact
to mailing lists at the same time.
If the contact already exists and you pass mailing_list_ids, it REPLACES the contact

tool_signatures.name: boldem_create_unsubscribe
tool_signatures.description:
Unsubscribe an email address or phone number. The contact will no longer receive
mass email campaigns (or SMS, for a phone number). Either email or phone is required.
Pass mailing_list_id to unsubscribe from a single list instead of everything.
Returns 409 if the unsubscribe already exists.

phone.description: Phone number to unsubscribe, international format (max 30 chars)

mailing_list_id.description: Unsubscribe from this mailing list only

parameters.name: mailing_list_id
parameters.description: Unsubscribe from this mailing list only

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Phone number to unsubscribe, international format (max 30 chars)

tool_signatures.name: boldem_delete_campaign
tool_signatures.description: Permanently delete a mass email campaign by ID. This cannot be undone.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_delete_contact
tool_signatures.description:
Permanently delete a contact, identified by ID or email address. This action cannot be undone.
Use boldem_find_contacts first to verify you have the correct contact.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_delete_unsubscribe

tool_signatures.name: boldem_execute_campaign
tool_signatures.description:
Start sending a mass email campaign. The campaign must be ready to send.
This is an asynchronous operation — it returns immediately and the campaign sends in the background.
WARNING: This actually sends emails to real contacts.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_find_contacts
tool_signatures.description:
Search for contacts in Boldem. Find a specific contact by ID or email address,
or list/filter contacts with pagination. Returns contact details including name,
email, status, custom fields, and mailing list assignments.
Use this when the user asks about contacts, subscribers, or wants to look up an email address.

tool_signatures.description:
List automations in Boldem. Automations are workflows that trigger actions
(send email, add tag, etc.) based on events (contact created, order placed, etc.).

tool_signatures.description: List campaign executions (sends) with filtering and pagination. Shows execution status, dates, and stats.

tool_signatures.description: List campaign schedulers. Schedulers allow you to plan campaign sends at a specific date and time.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_list_campaigns
tool_signatures.description:
List mass email campaigns in Boldem with optional filtering and pagination.
Shows campaign name, status, creation date, and associated mailing lists.
Use this when the user asks about their email campaigns or newsletters.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_list_carts
tool_signatures.description: List shopping carts in Boldem. Carts are used for abandoned cart email automations.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_list_contact_activities
tool_signatures.description:
List activities (opens, clicks, bounces, etc.) for contacts.
Filter by contact email or ID to see a specific contact

tool_signatures.name: boldem_list_coupon_groups
tool_signatures.description: List coupon groups. Groups organize coupons into collections for use in campaigns.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_list_coupons
tool_signatures.description:
List coupons in Boldem with filtering and pagination. Coupons can be used
in email campaigns for personalized discount codes.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_list_custom_event_schemas
tool_signatures.description:
List available custom event schemas. Schemas define the structure of custom events
(field names, types, session handling and retention). You need a schema NAME to create
custom events. Schemas themselves can only be created and deleted in the Boldem UI —
the API exposes them read-only.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_list_data_sources
tool_signatures.description:
List data sources. Data sources represent external systems connected to Boldem
(e.g. e-shop integrations, CRM connections).

tool_signatures.name: boldem_list_dispatchers
tool_signatures.description:
List dispatchers (email senders). A dispatcher represents a sender identity
(name + email) used to send campaigns. You need a dispatcher ID when creating campaigns.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_list_email_groups
tool_signatures.description: List transactional email groups. Groups organize transactional emails for reporting.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_list_global_variables
tool_signatures.description:
List global variables. Global variables are reusable values (e.g. company name,
support email) that can be used across all email templates and campaigns.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_list_html_templates
tool_signatures.description: List HTML templates. These are raw HTML templates that can be used for transactional emails.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_list_mailing_lists
tool_signatures.description:
List all mailing lists in Boldem with optional filtering and pagination.
Mailing lists are used to organize contacts into groups for campaigns.
Use this to find mailing list IDs needed for other operations like assigning contacts or sending campaigns.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_list_mass_emails
tool_signatures.description:
List individual emails sent as part of a campaign execution.
Shows delivery status for each recipient in the campaign.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_list_mass_message_campaigns
tool_signatures.description: List mass message (SMS) campaigns with filtering and pagination.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_list_orders
tool_signatures.description:
List orders in Boldem with filtering and pagination. Orders are synced from
your e-shop and used for segmentation and automation triggers.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_list_products
tool_signatures.description:
List products in Boldem with pagination. Products are used for e-commerce
integrations, abandoned cart emails, and product recommendation campaigns.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_list_subscribe_requests
tool_signatures.description:
List subscribe requests (double opt-in). Shows pending and confirmed subscription
requests from contacts who signed up via forms.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_list_template_snippets
tool_signatures.description:
List template snippets. Snippets are reusable content blocks (e.g. headers,
footers) that can be included in templates.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_list_templates
tool_signatures.description:
List email templates in Boldem. Templates are used for mass email campaigns
and can be of types: UserHtml, DndEditor, Sms, PlainText.
Use this to find template IDs for creating campaigns.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_list_transactional_emails
tool_signatures.description: List transactional emails that were sent, with their delivery state.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_list_transactional_sms
tool_signatures.description: List transactional SMS messages that were sent, with their delivery state and price.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_list_unsubscribes
tool_signatures.description:
List unsubscribes (opt-outs) with optional filtering and pagination.
Unsubscribes cover both email addresses and phone numbers.

someone unsubscribed.

tool_signatures.name: boldem_send_transactional_email
tool_signatures.description:
Send a transactional email through Boldem. The email is sent asynchronously and the
call returns a GUID you can pass to boldem_get_transactional_email to check delivery.

Provide the content either by template_id (a transactional template — use
boldem_list_templates) or directly via body_html / body_text with a subject.
group_id only files the email under a transactional email group for reporting;
it is not the template. Use boldem_list_email_groups for group IDs.
